title: AI coding startup Cognition reportedly already in talks to raise at $40B valuation
summary: Cognition may be looking to raise another mega round just a few months after raising $1 billion at a $26 billion valuation.
title_es: Cognition busca financiación de $40B tras serie de $1B hace meses
bajada: La startup de coding IA Cognition estaría en conversaciones para recaudar a una valoración de $40 mil millones, solo meses después de cerrar una ronda de $1 mil millones a $26 mil millones. El movimiento refleja el fervor inversor en herramientas de IA para desarrolladores.
bajada_en: AI coding startup Cognition is reportedly in talks to raise at a $40B valuation, just months after closing a $1B round at $26B. The move reflects intense investor appetite for developer-focused AI tools.

title: Amazon will train on Twitch streamers’ content by default, unless they opt out
summary: "If this was opt-in, nobody would opt in," Twitch CPO Mike Minton said on a livestream responding to user feedback. "That's honestly the answer."
title_es: Amazon entrenará con contenido de Twitch por defecto sin consentimiento previo
bajada: Amazon usará contenido de streamers de Twitch para entrenar IA generativa por defecto, con opción de no participar. El CPO de Twitch admitió que si fuera opt-in, nadie participaría, generando preocupaciones sobre privacidad y derechos de creadores.
bajada_en: Amazon will train on Twitch streamers' content by default unless they opt out. Twitch's CPO admitted opt-in would result in no participation, raising concerns over creator rights and privacy.

title: From assistance to execution: How enterprises put AI to work
summary: OpenAI research reveals how enterprises are adopting agentic AI, using ChatGPT and Codex, and how frontier firms are pulling ahead in AI adoption.
title_es: OpenAI: Cómo las empresas están ejecutando IA en producción
bajada: OpenAI publica investigación sobre cómo las empresas adoptan IA agéntica y usan ChatGPT y Codex en operaciones reales. El estudio revela que las empresas líderes están ganando ventaja competitiva significativa en la adopción de IA.
bajada_en: OpenAI releases research on how enterprises are adopting agentic AI and deploying ChatGPT and Codex in production. The study shows that leading companies are pulling ahead with significant competitive advantages in AI adoption.

title: OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings raises $2B to bring AI to the enterprise
summary: Thrive Holdings has raised $2 billion in new funding at a $12 billion valuation from investors like SoftBank, D1 Capital Partners, and Altimeter Capital.
title_es: Thrive Holdings levanta $2B para llevar IA a empresas
bajada: La startup respaldada por OpenAI Thrive Holdings cerró una ronda de $2 mil millones a $12 mil millones de valoración con inversores como SoftBank y D1 Capital. El financiamiento subraya el enfoque en soluciones de IA empresariales.
bajada_en: OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings raises $2B at a $12B valuation from investors like SoftBank and D1 Capital. The funding underscores focus on enterprise AI solutions.

title: The White House Is Going to Expand Its AI Policy
summary: Open models may soon be added to an updated AI framework, sources tell WIRED, as the White House continues to grapple with how to regulate a technology it has tried not to regulate.
title_es: Casa Blanca ampliará política de IA para incluir modelos abiertos
bajada: La Casa Blanca considera añadir modelos de IA abiertos a su marco regulatorio actualizado, según reportes. El movimiento reconoce que la regulación debe adaptarse a la realidad de los modelos open-source que están transformando la industria.
bajada_en: The White House is considering adding open AI models to an updated regulatory framework. The move acknowledges that regulation must adapt to the reality of open-source models transforming the industry.

title: Grok is now an AI ‘teammate’ you can assign work
summary: SpaceXAI has introduced Grok Bot, an always-on AI agent service designed to behave like independent "AI teammates" that can do your work for you. The bots share their own cloud-based computer environment, and can sign into apps, tools, and websites you already use to complete multi-step workplace tasks, only coming back when their assigned work […]
title_es: Grok Bot: Agentes de IA que trabajan como compañeros de equipo
bajada: SpaceX AI lanzó Grok Bot en beta, un agente de IA siempre activo que funciona como compañero de trabajo independiente capaz de acceder a apps y completar tareas complejas. Representa el movimiento hacia IA agéntica que ejecuta trabajo sin supervisión constante.
bajada_en: SpaceX AI launches Grok Bot in beta, an always-on AI agent that acts as an independent teammate capable of accessing apps and completing multi-step tasks. It represents the shift toward agentic AI that executes work autonomously.

title: cactus-compute /needle
summary: Needle 2 Needle 2 is an open 45M-parameter model for tool calling, device use and structured extraction. The whole model is a single 14MB binary that runs a full session in about 28MB of RAM. It is built on our Simple Attention Network findings, compressed to CQ2-bit with Cactus Quants, and baked into its own engine. On the benchmarks below, Needle 2 trades wins with other small models like FunctionGemma 270M, LFM2.5 230M and Apple FM, at 5x to 70x smaller, and 2 bits against their f16. This repository is the Python package: inference, LoRA fine-tuning, and export. pip install cactus-needle , describe your tools, and call them from Python. The inference engine is fetched once from Hugging Face and cached; there is nothing else to build. Self-contained : weights baked into a single 14MB engine; no separate model files to manage, and inference does no network. Simple contract : tool calls come back as structured data, text in, JSON out; a byte-level grammar compiled from your schemas constrains every token. Confidence-gated : every response carries a calibrated confidence score from a learned head; set a threshold, act above it, escalate below it. Tool retrieval : declare a large catalogue and a built-in retrieval head renders only the top five tools per turn, with the grammar constrained to that subset. Bounded memory : a 256-token sliding window with the tools pinned as KV sinks, so total memory stays near 28MB no matter how long the conversation runs. Weights: huggingface.co/Cactus-Compute/needle2 · source: github.com/cactus-compute/needle . Simple Attention Network Needle 2 is a Simple Attention Network, our dense small-model recipe: a Hadamard MLP in place of the FFN, GQA attention, engram key-value memory, and multi-lane hyper-connections. See the paper for the design and ablations: arXiv:2607.18363 . Each block carries its update rule. title_es: Needle 2: Modelo de 45M parámetros para llamadas de herramientas
bajada: Cactus Compute lanza Needle 2, un modelo open-source de 45 millones de parámetros para tool calling y extracción estructurada que cabe en un binario de 14MB. Compite con modelos 5-70x más grandes usando compresión CQ2-bit.
bajada_en: Cactus Compute releases Needle 2, an open 45M-parameter model for tool calling and structured extraction in a single 14MB binary. It competes with models 5-70x larger using CQ2-bit compression.

title: Someone is running mass vulnerability scans, spoofing AI bots like ClaudeBot
title_es: Escaneo masivo de vulnerabilidades suplantando bots de IA detectado
bajada: Se detectó actividad de escaneo masivo de vulnerabilidades que suplanta bots de IA como ClaudeBot. El incidente abre preocupaciones sobre seguridad de agentes de IA y validación de identidad en producción.
bajada_en: Mass vulnerability scans spoofing AI bots like ClaudeBot detected in the wild. The incident raises security concerns about AI agents and identity validation in production environments.

title: Class Is in Session: GeForce NOW Levels Up Linux, Chromebooks and More
summary: GeForce NOW is giving cloud gaming an extra-credit upgrade just in time for back-to-school season. The native Linux app for GeForce NOW is officially out of beta. GeForce NOW is also delivering new cloud optimizations that make Frame Generation feel even more responsive while streaming. On top of that, Performance members will see higher frame […]
title_es: GeForce NOW lanza app nativa para Linux y mejoras en cloud gaming
bajada: NVIDIA sacó de beta la aplicación nativa de GeForce NOW para Linux y añadió optimizaciones de nube que mejoran la respuesta de Frame Generation. Las mejoras permiten mejor experiencia de streaming para usuarios de Linux y Chromebooks.
bajada_en: NVIDIA launches native GeForce NOW app for Linux out of beta with cloud optimizations for Frame Generation. The improvements deliver better streaming responsiveness for Linux and Chromebook users.

title: Some Claude users are mad that Anthropic’s new watermarks will catch them using it at their jobs, classes
summary: Is Anthropic's new watermarking system a travesty? Some have taken to social media to complain that it is.
title_es: Usuarios de Claude critican marcas de agua de Anthropic por detección laboral
bajada: Algunos usuarios se quejan en redes sociales sobre las nuevas marcas de agua de Anthropic que podrían identificar uso de Claude en trabajos o clases. La tensión refleja el debate sobre transparencia versus privacidad en herramientas de IA.
bajada_en: Some Claude users complain on social media about Anthropic's new watermarks that could detect usage in jobs and classrooms. The tension reflects the debate over transparency versus privacy in AI tools.

title: Twitch streamers can now opt out from training Amazon’s AI
summary: Twitch users can now opt out of allowing their content to be used to train Amazon's generative AI models. Opting out means that "your streams, VODs, clips, stream chats, and pictures and text on your channel" won't be used in "future training" of an Amazon AI model "whose purpose is to generate or synthesize text, […]
title_es: Streamers de Twitch pueden optar por no participar en entrenamiento de IA
bajada: Los usuarios de Twitch pueden ahora rechazar que Amazon use sus streams, VODs, clips y chats para entrenar modelos de IA generativa. La opción permite que creadores controlen el uso de su contenido en modelos futuros.
bajada_en: Twitch users can now opt out of having their content used to train Amazon's generative AI models. The option lets creators control whether their streams, VODs, and chats are used for future AI training.

title: LFM2.5-VL-3B for Better and Faster Vision Capabilities for the Edge
title_es: LFM2.5-VL-3B: Modelo de visión ultraligero para edge
bajada: Liquid AI presenta LFM2.5-VL-3B, un modelo de visión de 3 mil millones de parámetros optimizado para dispositivos edge. El modelo busca llevar capacidades de visión avanzadas a dispositivos con recursos limitados.
bajada_en: Liquid AI releases LFM2.5-VL-3B, a 3B parameter vision model optimized for edge devices. The model brings advanced vision capabilities to resource-constrained devices.

title: NVIDIA-NeMo /Switchyard
summary:
Switchyard Switchyard is a Rust proxy and library for LLM traffic. It routes requests
across providers, translates between OpenAI and Anthropic APIs, records
operational metrics, and provides typed, composable routing algorithms. Why Switchyard? Point a coding agent such as Claude Code or Codex at an
open-source model. Switchyard translates between the OpenAI Chat, Anthropic
Messages, and OpenAI Responses formats, so the agent keeps speaking its native
API while the request is served by vLLM, NVIDIA NIM, Ollama, or any
OpenAI-compatible endpoint. The same proxy can spread traffic across several
models for A/B benchmarking, apply signal-driven stage routing, or run a custom
algorithm you write yourself. Features Protocol Translation : convert between OpenAI Chat, Anthropic Messages, and OpenAI Responses formats Multi-Backend Routing : random routing, LLM-as-classifier routing, signal-driven stage-router, or your own algorithm Operational Metrics : Prometheus metrics cover requests, errors, latency, tokens, and routing overhead Maturity Switchyard is pre-alpha software that is evolving rapidly. The API and algorithms are expected to change significantly before we reach v1.0. Warning Experimental software. Not for production use. Quick Start Choose the launcher path to run Claude Code, Codex CLI, or OpenClaw through
Switchyard. Choose the server path to run Switchyard as a standalone proxy.
Choose the library path to embed routing in your own Rust application. Launcher Path Install uv if it is
not already available, then install the published Switchyard tool: curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh source " $HOME /.local/bin/env " uv tool install --python 3.10 " nemo-switchyard[cli] " The coding agent you launch must also be installed and on your PATH . This does
not install the standalone switchyard-server binary; use the Server Path for
that. Set an OpenRouter key and launch against the packaged deployment: export OPENROUTER_API_KEY= " your-openrouter-key " #
title_es: Switchyard: Proxy de Rust para ruteo de tráfico de LLMs
bajada: NVIDIA NeMo lanza Switchyard, un proxy en Rust que enruta requests entre proveedores de LLM y traduce entre APIs OpenAI y Anthropic. La herramienta permite agentes de IA trabajar con múltiples backends y modelos transparentemente.
bajada_en: NVIDIA NeMo releases Switchyard, a Rust proxy that routes LLM requests across providers and translates between OpenAI and Anthropic APIs. The tool enables AI agents to work with multiple backends transparently.

title: Introducing OlmoEarth embeddings: Custom embedding exports from OlmoEarth Studio for downstream analysis
title_es: Hugging Face: Embeddings personalizados de OlmoEarth para análisis
bajada: Allen AI introduce exportación de embeddings personalizados desde OlmoEarth Studio para análisis específicos. La herramienta permite que developers trabajen con representaciones de datos adaptadas a sus necesidades.
bajada_en: Allen AI introduces custom embedding exports from OlmoEarth Studio for downstream analysis. The tool lets developers work with data representations tailored to their specific needs.

title: If I own Claude's outputs why can't I train my own model on them?
title_es: Debate: ¿Pueden usuarios entrenar modelos con outputs de Claude?
bajada: Usuarios cuestionan por qué no pueden entrenar modelos propios con contenido generado por Claude si son propietarios del output. Anthropic establece límites legales sobre uso de outputs para training de modelos competidores.
bajada_en: Users question whether they can train their own models on Claude outputs if they own them. Anthropic clarifies legal restrictions on using outputs for training competing models.
